text: I've run the canal gates for Doran since I was thirteen.
Doran trusts me with schedules he used to keep only in his own head.
Mara is teaching me to weigh harvest grain against the standard stones properly.
I want to learn full tally-reading, not just counting notches.
Kiri and I compare notes when our paths cross near the pasture fence.
She's told me herders avoid a stretch of the Old Canal Bed. I've noticed the canal banks near there crack more than elsewhere too.
I don't know if those two things are related, but I want to find out.
The old folk in the Lower Town tell the Turning like it was one bad night.
Doran tells it like it took years. I believe Doran; he lived through more of it.
I saw the archive-keeper's house from a distance once. Doran said not to bother her.
I didn't ask why, but I noticed he said it kindly, not sharply.
I've started noting which gates need repair more often than others.
The ones nearest the Old Canal Bed need it most.
I keep my own small notebook of these things, separate from Doran's official log.
